messages.subject: Lunch & Learn: Recent developments in IP licensing — 28 October
messages.plaintextBody: Join us for a CPD-accredited session on recent developments in patent and know-how licensing, including FRAND issues and the UPC. 12:30-13:30 in the Bishopsgate training room, lunch provided. Please RSVP to Knowledge & Learning.
